items.note: For the bit network the plan follows the paper's proof: the eight-row schedule gives (JV+RG)x whatever a and c are, the central coefficient is |S cap T| mod 2 with side wires cancelling intersection one, and forward/inverse/forward stages yield (-y,x). But the lemma covers both constructions. The complex scalar network (even-intersection neighbours, coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, wire C_*) and the neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c (lines 756-758, 767-782) never appear, although S2.1 relies on that network.

S1.3.2 states the setup exactly: a common invertible frame per gate, D_v D_u^{-1} on edges, implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}. It cites the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate. It is a single infer step with no method or invariant argument, so it counts as stated.

Every part of the paper's derivation is present: the form I-J/9 with <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, the gate order and labels inside (B x F) perp (P x F), the side edge 2->5 inclusion through t_X perp t_Y, the only loss of h on centre 3->4, telescoping to Wm-2N, and the 2L correction with L=Ich. The ratios 100/539 and 101/539 and the binary orthonormal bases are also given.

The plan matches the proof: projections P_U at gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} at X_a sources; rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U; the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one; s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b; and endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (zero to identity on the other roles).

The plan follows the paper's proof: phase frames with wt(P_U x) mod 4, weight additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd-weight basis vectors turned into translation kernels aI+bX_v by Hadamard conjugation, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and the 27 inverted coordinates on X_a->Y_a corrected by C=iZC^{-1}Z with the scalar i^{27k}.

The bit chain is complete: L_b/N=100/539<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, eta_b=339/22587335000000>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and so s_b/W_b<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. For the complex network the plan gives only L_c/N=101/539 and the deficit 2N-2L_c>0. The value eta_c and its comparison with 20*2^{-50} are missing, and S2.8 simply asserts s_c/W_c<=m^sigma.

The operations and the split-at-offset-and-merge-swapped mechanism are stated correctly. Two conditions are missing. S1.1 gives streams of volume V/W with no requirement that W divide the row count (lines 504-505, 523-526). S1.2 omits that q is prime and that the coefficients' denominators (and, for units, numerators) are prime to q.

The plan has the same elimination, with the topmost nonzero row and its rightmost pivot under lower-triangular operations giving A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones. The prime q avoids denominators and diagonal numerators, triangular updates run in descending physical order, and each one of Pi is realised as D+=H, interchange, D=H-D. So the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V).

The plan follows the paper's route. It splits rows cyclically into W role streams of volume V/W, places shear frames Phi_M, and obtains Phi_{I_m}, that is H<-H+D on every row. The updates D-=H, H+=D, D=H-D give the interchange. There are s child calls, an O(V) node cost including the fixed-tape parking schedule, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and F_k=O(e^tau).

The plan covers each part: high digits rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) as a row field of range q^{2rho}>=W^k padded below 2V, a base-m split with a_j<m and m^k<me giving O(Ve^tau), and binary padding to [q^e] with e=O(u). The remark on widths differing by one bit (1740-1762) is not treated, but it lies outside the lemma.

errors.says: Splitting whole rows cyclically into W streams of volume V/W each costs O(V).
errors.paper: The cyclic split always costs O(V). The streams have equal shape and volume V/W only when W divides the row count R, and the merge is stated under that condition.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route all the way to the main bound. S1 (bit network, labels, rank budget, matrix shear, recurrence, arbitrary width) and S2 (phase frames, packed bit addition, layer recurrence) supply the two fast tape operations. S3 to S4 turn them into transforms, convolution, resampling, CRT and exact recovery, and S5 does the cost accounting with min margin 2kappa. The tree is thin in a few places. The complex scalar network is never specified. The complex deficit eta_c and the guard-width depth recurrence are asserted rather than derived. The layer recurrence leaves out the base-m split of the remaining chunks.

steps.note: S1.3.1 gives banks X_a, Y_a indexed by a in T^3 (triples of [100]) and the fixed network (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) that restores every scratch wire. S1.3.3.6 gives N=v^3 with v=C(100,3). m=h^3 appears only implicitly, through the label space (Q^h)^{x3} and I_m, but the defining content is present.

S1.3.2 has a shared invertible frame per gate, D_v D_u^{-1} on edges, implementing D_out S D_in^{-1} with route operator eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1} whatever the intermediate frames. It cites the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate. S1.3.5 applies this with shear frames.

Each gate is labelled by a nondegenerate subspace of (Q^h)^{x3} (dimension h^3=m). Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are the central edges from time 3 to 4, each losing h (P x F x Q).
For nested U in V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, so an edge costs its label change. The N first edges on X_a are the exceptions, with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero.
The signed changes telescope to W_b m-2N, and the Ic decreasing edges with loss h add 2L with L=Ich, so the absolute changes sum to Wm-2N+2L. The N source ranks then give s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
The plan gives L_b/N=3*100*100/v=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (bit) and 2N-2L_c>0 (complex), giving s<Wm.

S1.3.3.7.4 gives M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} on X_a, zero to identity elsewhere). S1.3.5 turns this into Phi_{I_m}, so H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.

The rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges (one per one of Pi, between two controlled updates) plus O(V). S1.3.7.1 concludes that a node makes exactly s recursive calls, each on volume V/W.
Children have volume V/W, F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). eta_b=339/22587335000000>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 give s_b/W_b<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving, in the paper's order and roles. The fixed bank-exchange network on triples of [100] gets frames that commute with pointwise gates, and nested labels whose only losses are h on the central 3->4 edges. Rank equals dimension change, giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with L_b/N=100/539<1/2 and the endpoint identity I_m. Each edge becomes rank-many interchanges by the E_1 Pi E_2 shear. The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^{1-2^{-50}} gives O(e^tau). The only gap is that m=h^3 is left implicit.
